iut_type: End Product — BR/EDR-only product using Combine Unmodified Design
customer_question: What does our company need to prepare in advance for the test and registration process (test samples, equipment, documents)?
question_variants: What materials and equipment do we need to provide for Bluetooth RF testing?
What technical documents are required for the compliance folder?
How many test units do we need to send, and do they need modification?
What do we need to submit before and after testing for registration?
actual_issue: Ahead of testing, the customer asked what preparation was required on their side. The consultant specified: (1) one test unit is needed, and it requires a hardware modification described in a separate attached document; (2) if available, a PC application from the SoC vendor for putting the device into test/DUT mode is needed as supporting test environment/equipment; (3) prior to testing, the customer must submit a completed QUESTIONNAIRE (provided as an attachment), and after test completion must submit a registration-content confirmation document; (4) for the compliance folder needed by registration completion, the customer must supply: (a) an operation manual covering the Bluetooth-related portion, (b) a product block diagram, (c) a product outline/dimensional drawing, and (d) an antenna datasheet including the radiation gain pattern chart.
plain_english_explanation: Before Bluetooth certification testing can start, the customer needs to hand over a modified test sample, fill out a vendor questionnaire, and after the test, sign off on the registration details. They also need to gather a set of technical documents for the compliance folder: an operating manual, block diagram, outline drawing, and an antenna datasheet showing the radiation gain pattern. This is a checklist of logistics required to actually run the project, distinct from the technical scoping questions about which tests apply.
consultant_answer: Required preparation: (1) Test units: 1 unit, modified per the attached instructions. (2) Test environment/equipment: if available, the SoC vendor's PC application for entering DUT test mode. (3) Documents to submit before testing: the attached QUESTIONNAIRE; after test completion: a registration-content confirmation document. (4) Compliance folder technical documents needed by registration completion: operation manual (Bluetooth section), product block diagram, product outline drawing, and antenna datasheet (including radiation gain pattern). No other preparation items are needed beyond this list.
decision_logic: Required preparation is split into three buckets: physical test sample (with vendor-specified modification), pre/post-test administrative documents (questionnaire, confirmation document), and compliance-folder technical documentation (manual, diagrams, antenna data) needed for the registration record. All four compliance-folder document types are mandatory; the DUT-mode PC application is conditional on availability from the SoC vendor.
final_recommendation: Provide customers a single consolidated preparation checklist early (test sample + modification instructions, vendor questionnaire, post-test confirmation document, and the four compliance-folder documents) so they can gather materials in parallel with the registration/quoting process rather than after testing begins.
risk_if_done_wrong: Missing or late submission of the questionnaire, confirmation document, or compliance-folder technical documents (manual, block diagram, outline drawing, antenna datasheet with gain pattern) can delay registration completion even after RF testing itself is finished.
